# `auth_event`

Authentication events (AUD-01): logins, failures, lockouts, MFA, sessions, password changes. Append-only for every role. Tenant-relevant events are also written to that tenant's audit_event.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Owner module | platform |
| Kind | append-only-log |
| Tenant scope | Not tenant scoped |
| Runtime access | Granted to runtime roles (see migration grants) |
| Effective / recorded time | `occurred_at` |
| Retention class | `audit-trail`: Per audit category within legal minimums, with legal hold (AUD-07). Period: not yet decided. |
| API mapping | — |
| Write path | AuthService only. |
| Migration behaviour | Created in 0005_auth (expand). |

## Constraints

- PK (id)
- event and result from fixed lists
- UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE rejected for every role
- no email or password ever stored
